app.name: Potato Mesh
app.one_liner: A federated, Meshtastic and Meshcore node dashboard for your local community with no MQTT clutter, just local LoRa aether.

screens.name: Node Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display real-time nodes, positions, neighbors, trace routes, telemetry, and messages on a map and in a chat window.
primary_actions: Read new node notifications and telemetry logs in chat
Search and filter nodes in map and table view
View map with colocated node spider-net visualization

rust_commands.name: post_telemetry
rust_commands.purpose: Authenticate and store incoming telemetry, messages, or node data via the REST API.

mvp_plan: week 1: Implement authenticated POST/GET API endpoints
week 1: Integrate basic map and chat UI components
week 1: Set up Ruby/Sinatra web server with SQLite backend
acceptance_tests: Given a valid API_TOKEN, telemetry can be posted to /api/v1/telemetry and appears in the dashboard within 5 seconds.
When two nodes share the same location, the map renders them as a collapsible spider-net cluster.
